summary: Implemented all 8 plan phases' code (zot CLI package, sops secret + always-on wiring, fish/bash exports, systemd --user env oneshot, declarative config.toml activation, disabled-by-default translation-server with two live-discovered bugs fixed). 2 of 8 phases fully verified live and COMPLETED; 5 PARTIAL and 1 BLOCKED solely on two anticipated capability boundaries: no zotero.org browser access (rotation) and sudo denied this session (nixos-rebuild switch). All builds green; home-manager-only verification fully exercised live.

blockers.description: Key rotation (Phase 1): creating a new Zotero API key and revoking the old one requires a zotero.org browser session unavailable to the implementing agent. Secret was seeded with the existing, still-valid key instead (grants verified). Operator must create a new key, sops --set it in, then revoke the old one per docs/zotero.md's rotation runbook.

sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#hamsa was not run: every sudo invocation was denied outright by this session's permission policy (not merely unauthenticated). /run/secrets/zotero_api_key therefore does not exist, which blocks the live verification of Phases 4-8's secret-dependent checks (fresh-shell env vars, systemd --user show-environment, ~/.config/zot/config.toml content, the env -i credential exercise, and removing the pre-existing plaintext export in ~/.config/fish/conf.d/private.fish, which is deliberately gated on a precedence assertion that itself needs the switch). nix flake check and nixos-rebuild build both succeed; home-manager switch was run live ~8 times successfully. Operator must run the switch, then the deferred checks listed in the summary's Operator Actions Outstanding section.

decisions_made: Seeded the sops secret with the pre-existing key rather than leaving it empty, per explicit scope instruction, so Phases 2-8 are testable end-to-end today.

iso/usb-installer nix build failures are a pre-existing, unrelated zfs-kernel breakage (confirmed via git-stash A/B) — the always-on secrets module import stays in modules/system/default.nix, no per-host-import fallback needed.

zotero-translation-server overridden onto pkgs.nodejs_22 (default nodejs=24 crashes the bundled config npm package on every startup) and NODE_CONFIG single-quoted at the systemd unit level (systemd's Environment= parser strips unquoted inner double quotes) — both bugs found and fixed live, not in the original plan.
private.fish line 49 deliberately NOT removed: the plan's hard constraint requires a live precedence assertion first, which is blocked on the same sudo-denied nixos-rebuild switch.
dead_ends: nodejs_20 override for zotero-translation-server — marked insecure on this nixpkgs channel, refuses to build without an explicit permittedInsecurePackages allowlist entry.
